subject: Access custodian snapshot & provisioning artifacts request
messages:
From: controls@healthsync.com
To: soojin_lee
Cc: alice.davies@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access custodian snapshot + provisioning artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on intake. As part of HealthSync's SIG review we're collecting a small set of artifacts focused on access control and provisioning. Would you be able to provide the following within the next 5 business days?

- A redacted SCIM delta snapshot (CSV) covering the past 30 days (include create/update/deactivate timestamps and the identity_source column).
- One or two representative SAML assertion samples (no PII) showing NameID format and group/role claims.
- A current role-owner mapping (CSV) that lists role_id, role_name, owner_email, and least_privilege justification (short text).
- A short note describing how service accounts are scoped (naming conventions, expiry, owner steward).

We will accept redacted outputs and reconciled snapshots (not raw logs) as long as the change history is preserved. If there's an internal owner-custodian ledger or reconciliation report you prefer to share instead of the role-owner CSV, that works too — just let us know.

Also confirm whether the SCIM export includes soft-deletes or if deprovision events are only in a separate audit stream. If you have a sample SCIM delta with deprovision timestamps included, that would be ideal.

Thanks — Alice (on the Controls team)

[HealthSync Controls]
[Attachment request: Sig questionnaire section references: CAIQ-A5, SIG-Access-2]
From: soojin_lee
To: controls@healthsync.com
Cc: jordan_blake, naomi_feldman
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access custodian snapshot + provisioning artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Alice — thanks for the details and the scope call-out. We can deliver the artifacts you requested; please see the attached stubs and notes.

Deliverables attached to this message:
- saml_assertion_samples.xml (SAML assertions with group and role claims; PII fields redacted)
- scim_delta_snapshot.csv (30-day delta including create/update/deactivate timestamps; identity_source included)

What we'll follow up with in the next 48 hours:
- role_owner_roster_20280528.csv (role_id, role_name, owner_email, short justification) — we are finalizing a small reconciliation with the product team to ensure owner emails are current.
- short scope note on service accounts and expiry policy (inline below).

Quick notes on exports/format and redaction:
- SCIM delta: includes soft-delete rows under operation=DELETE with a deleted_at timestamp column. We redacted usernames to hashed_id values in the export; unique identifiers are preserved so you can trace events.
- SAML samples: NameID is transient-persistent format, role claims are present under 'roles' and 'groups' attributes. No phone/address PII included.
- Service accounts: named with prefix svc-<team>-<purpose>, TTL enforced via automated rotation policy (90 days) unless an exception is approved and tracked in our owner ledger. Owner steward is required at creation and must be a human owner in the role_owner_roster.

If you'd prefer the SCIM delta un-redacted over a secure transfer (we can RTP via a signed S3 link), tell us and we'll initiate an ephemeral link with encryption at rest.

On the reconciliation: Naomi is running the owner normalization job this week and will drop the final CSV into the Drive link below once complete.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF_example_link

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake

Cc: soojin_lee
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access custodian snapshot + provisioning artifacts for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Alice — looping in a couple technical clarifications.

1) The SCIM delta we provided includes an operation column (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE), a changed_at timestamp in ISO8601, and a identity_source column (idp/redwood-provisioner). Deprovision events use operation=DELETE and deleted_at is populated. If you need the raw audit log entries for deprovision (actor, request_id), we can produce those but they are in a separate audit export.

2) Role-owner roster: we are including both the declared owner and the last_confirmed_at timestamp so you can see how recent the owner review was. Naomi is adding the justification snippets (1-2 sentence least-privilege rationale).

3) Service accounts: if your controls reviewers want a short playbook excerpt on rotation and KMS integration, I can attach that as a PDF.

No action needed now — Soojin will drop the final roster CSV.

— Jordan
Principal, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

If you can drop the CSV and confirm a method for the owner attestation by end of day tomorrow (2028-05-29), we should be able to close the SIG access section.

Thanks — Alice (controls@healthsync.com)
